explanation.headline: Celecoxib is not on FDA's shortage list; our two sites hold 34 and 27 days on hand and the labeled repackager Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC received a VAI inspection on 2024-09-06

sentences.text: Corvale East holds 441 units at 13.2 units per day, providing 34 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 525 units at 19.3 units per day, providing 27 days on hand.
The product label for NDC 80425009602 names Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC as the repackager with FEI 3017450153.
FDA inspection 1249914 of that facility ended on 2024-09-06 and was classified VAI.
The inspection classification was made known to FDA on 2024-11-13 per an FMD-145 letter.

rejected.text: FDA's public shortage list does not include celecoxib as of today 2026-10-21.
Check current allocation from A-S Medication Solutions and verify whether any other labeled manufacturers have supply disruptions not yet posted by FDA.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-9a7d0d.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%celecoxib%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%celecoxib%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-e6284f.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('b3545cfb-97c3-b896-e053-2a95a90a15a0') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-2c6c1c.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%celecoxib%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-423701.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%celecoxib%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-616b8f.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%celecoxib%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-20b22c.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3017450153') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-37f066.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3017450153') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-f8d8b8.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3017450153') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('advanced rx tennessee', 'advanced rx pharmacy tennessee')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-c9f26e.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('advanced rx tennessee', 'advanced rx pharmacy tennessee') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%celecoxib%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-047a6d.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('80425009602')

Q-c75d60.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%celecoxib%'
